verdict.line: You lose if you trade with autos into a live Riposte and let Fiora out-sustain you past level 6; you win if you land Fury-empowered W stuns and close the fight before she resets with Lunge and Burst of Speed.

brief.thesis: Renekton holds the lane and solo-kill edge because his Fury-empowered W (Ruthless Predator) out-trades her early, but Riposte (W) only parries basic attacks, so every auto you throw into her active parry window is a wasted trade that boosts her Attack Damage. Over 483 recorded games this pans out to a losing 44.9% win rate for Renekton, meaning her Duelist sustain and double-Lunge kiting reliably claw back the early lane deficit.

theirWindow.what: She can hold it up in any extended trade. Don't throw basic attacks to bait it out; stick to Q/W/E spell damage since Riposte only parries autos, and if you see her W flash active, cancel your attack-move command immediately.

yourWindow.when: Fury is above 50 and her Q/E are down
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in: empowered W hits three times for a 1.5s stun and shreds shields, empowered E shreds Armor on the way in, and Q heals for more. Commit here rather than poking with autos.

start.why: 46.8% win rate over 438 games and the dominant 75.9% pick — the extra sustain and damage matter more here than Doran's Shield since your job is to win short all-in windows, not stall.

boots.why: 86% pick rate and the standard choice into a champion whose entire kit (autos, Lunge follow-ups) is physical damage and attack-speed driven.

core.why: Shield-and-burst passive syncs with your Fury all-in window and punishes her for standing in Riposte range.
Stacking Armor shred compounds with your empowered E's own Armor reduction, letting your team's damage through.
Best-performing third item in recorded games (56.8% over 37 games); the shield and tenacity keep you alive through her Burst of Speed kite phase.

situational.when: her Duelist stacks are healing her back to full in every extended fight
you need to survive her burst to actually close out the trade
you're ahead and snowballing and want faster W/E cooldowns to chain all-ins

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest recorded win rate and pick rate (52%, 31.3% pick); the ramping adaptive stats and healing help you survive the extended trades this matchup forces rather than rewarding a single burst window Riposte can punish.

summoners.why: 48.5% win rate and the overwhelming 91% pick — Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into an actual kill before her Riposte/Lunge sustain lets her reset the trade.

playing.title: Track Riposte, not just her HP
playing.detail: Riposte only parries basic attacks, so autoing into it while it's up just feeds her free Attack Damage. Land your damage through Q, W, and E instead when you see it's available.

playing.title: Wait out her double Lunge
playing.detail: Fiora's Q can be thrown twice within a couple seconds at no extra cost. Don't commit your stun combo while she still has a second dash in reserve to disengage or reposition.

playing.title: Fury-check before every trade
playing.detail: Below 50 Fury your W is a single 0.75s stun with weaker damage. Auto-attack to build Fury between trades so your engages land as the empowered three-hit version.

playing.title: Lead all-ins with empowered E
playing.detail: Slice and Dice's empowered dash reduces the target's Armor before your follow-up W and Q land, maximizing the burst of your short combat window.

playing.title: Disengage from her Burst of Speed
playing.detail: Once she pops E, she out-trades and out-runs you. Reset instead of chasing or continuing to fight through it.

playing.title: Buy grievous wounds against sustain snowball
playing.detail: If her Duelist stacks are healing her through every trade by mid-game, Executioner's Calling shuts that down directly.

playing.title: Call for jungle help levels 3-5
playing.detail: Your solo-kill edge is real but this matchup trends losing overall, so use early jungler pressure to convert the lane lead into a kill before it evaporates.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being hit with Fiora’s Riposte (W) while in combat. Be careful of Vitals while building Fury to engage whenever your abilities come off cooldown.
